claims.claim: _prove_context accepts exactly the legacy browserContextIds=[] response and that response plus a non-empty string defaultBrowserContextId.

_prove_context rejects missing, malformed or non-empty browserContextIds, empty or non-string defaultBrowserContextId, and unknown response keys as BROWSER_CONTEXT_UNPROVEN. The optional default ID is used only for compatibility validation and supplies no identity or selection authority.
Context proof requires exactly one Playwright context matching the supplied snapshot, bounded browser-CDP-session operations, and the same context list after detach, with acquisition-deadline checks.

Expected context/session/page bridge and mapping failures are contained inside the acquisition boundary. Timeouts become ACQUISITION_TIMED_OUT; other supported operational failures become BROWSER_CONTEXT_UNPROVEN. Disconnect failures preserve the acquisition reason, and failed or uncertain creation grants no retry or second request.

Acquisition issues at most one new_page request, requires about:blank in the proved context with the expected page list, navigates only to Binding.chat_url, rejects competing targets and context/page drift, and repeats exact owner proof before exposing the page for editing.

The production-shaped regression uses inert launch, connection, OS and async bridge fixtures with the real bounded bridge and owner classifier. It covers both accepted context shapes through attach, owner proof, context proof, detach, one-page creation, exact navigation, second owner proof and existing pre-submit checks, then stops before editing or Send.

TASK-304 listener absence proof and TASK-305 profile occupancy and exact owner proof retain their original source. local_chat_wake.py and its regression file are unchanged from the supplied TASK base, preserving v3/origin-affinity, canonical freshness, dedupe, draft/generation, at-most-one submission, ambiguity and no-blind-resend logic. Existing unattended safety regression bodies are retained alongside the added acquisition regressions.

Documentation records the two production-compatible response shapes, opaque default-ID treatment, bounded stable-context proof and deterministic bridge-failure boundary. It preserves machine-local privacy requirements and the separate Human/Brain H4D live exit gate.

The clean failed candidate remains unchanged at the supplied failed_head_sha.
